# waroom_on_call_trigger (Resource)

Manages a Waroom on-call trigger. A trigger calls its escalation policies when an incident matching its filters is created in its service.

~> **Note:** A trigger is enabled by default (`enabled = true`), so once it is created, incidents that match its filters page the on-call members of its escalation policies. Set `enabled = false` to create it without paging anyone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "waroom_on_call_escalation_policy" "primary" {
  name = "Primary escalation"
}

# Call the primary escalation policy when a critical or high incident is created
# in my-service from an integration or the web UI, and retry the escalation twice
# when no one responds.
resource "waroom_on_call_trigger" "example" {
  name                    = "critical incidents"
  service_name            = "my-service"
  escalation_policy_uuids = [data.waroom_on_call_escalation_policy.primary.uuid]
  severity_filters        = ["critical", "high"]
  source_filters          = ["integration", "web"]
  retry_count             = 2
}

# A trigger is enabled by default. Set enabled = false to create it without paging anyone.
resource "waroom_on_call_trigger" "disabled" {
  name                    = "low incidents"
  service_name            = "my-service"
  escalation_policy_uuids = [data.waroom_on_call_escalation_policy.primary.uuid]
  severity_filters        = ["low"]
  enabled                 = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `escalation_policy_uuids` (Set of String) The UUIDs of the escalation policies the trigger calls. At least one is required.
- `name` (String) The name of the trigger.
- `service_name` (String) The name of the service the trigger belongs to. Changing it moves the trigger to another service.
- `severity_filters` (Set of String) The incident severities the trigger applies to: `critical`, `high`, `low`, `info` or `unknown`.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the trigger is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `event_type` (String) The event that fires the trigger. Currently only `incident_created`, which is the default.
- `retry_count` (Number) How many times the escalation restarts from the beginning when no one responds (0 to 10). Defaults to `0`.
- `source_filters` (Set of String) The incident sources the trigger applies to: `integration`, `slack` or `web`. Defaults to `["integration"]`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) On-call trigger ID. This is an alias for `uuid`.
- `uuid` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the trigger. This is automatically generated by Waroom.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# On-call triggers can be imported by specifying the trigger UUID
import {
  to = waroom_on_call_trigger.example
  id = "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# On-call triggers can be imported by specifying the trigger UUID
terraform import waroom_on_call_trigger.example 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
```
